evidence_quotes: O objetivo da ação é responsabilizar empresas e município pela construção de prédios em cima de aterro sanitário, o que gerou a contaminação ambiental e de lençol freático.
Dano ambiental com dever de recuperar a área, fixando-se a indenização para os prejudicados nos casos de demolição necessária e dos danos morais.
rationale: Public civil action (ação civil pública) brought by the Public Prosecutor's Office holding private companies (including COFAP) and the municipality jointly and severally liable under the polluter-pays principle for environmental and groundwater (lençol freático) contamination resulting from residential buildings constructed atop a contaminated landfill/waste site, ordering remediation studies, waste treatment, and potential demolition/indemnification. Because groundwater resource pollution is explicitly part of the adjudicated environmental harm alongside soil and gas contamination, both labels are coded WATER under environmental_protection (medium confidence given the broader solid-waste/contaminated-land focus).
